issues.detail: The assertion-0 regex requires the export_csv docstring to open with a bare `"""` (`\s*\x22{3}`). A correct run whose doctest Example shows written bytes or escapes (e.g. `b'...\r\n'`) would reasonably switch to a raw docstring `r"""`, and the check would then fail even though the docstring documents `columns`.
issues.fix: In documenter-16/spec.json, checks[0].all[1].contains.regex, change `:\\n\\s*\\x22{3}` to `:\\n\\s*[rRuU]?\\x22{3}` so the check reads `def export_csv[(]self, path, status=None, owner=None, columns=DEFAULT_COLUMNS[)]:\n\s*[rRuU]?\x22{3}(?:(?!\x22{3})[\s\S])*columns`.
